item.title: Booking-Style Hotel Site MVP
item.description:
250-750 EUR | I need an MVP that lets travellers search for hotels, see real-time availability, and secure a room in just a few clicks. For this first release the scope is intentionally narrow: hotels only—no apartments, hostels, or holiday homes—and the only module I care about right now is search-and-booking.
Core flow • Guests enter destination, dates, and guest count. • Results show available hotels with photos, amenities, room types, and up-to-date pricing. • On the hotel page they choose a room, then either pay online in full (Stripe, PayPal, or a similar gateway) or select “pay at the hotel.” • A confirmation email with a reservation code is sent automatically in both cases.
What’s out of scope for this phase: an owner extranet, loyalty programmes, reviews, or other post-stay features. Build the architecture with future modules in mind, but keep the current deliverable lean.
Deliverables (hand-off ready) • Responsive web application (frontend, backend, database schema) running on a test server plus all source code in Git. • Clear setup instructions and brief technical documentation.
Acceptance criteria • Search, booking, and the dual-payment option work end-to-end without errors. • Confirmation emails arrive within one minute. • Code is clean, readable, and modular for future expansion.

item.title: GoHighLevel Workflow Setup for Entertainment
item.description:
250-750 USD | I need our entire entertainment-company workflow rebuilt inside GoHighLevel so every team member can work from one, consistent platform. Today most enquiries arrive through our website forms, with a smaller stream pushed in from third-party lead companies; all of them must land in the same pipeline, properly tagged, and visible to staff the moment they arrive.
Once the intake is flowing, I want automations that send an instant acknowledgement to the prospect, assign the lead to the right internal owner, and trigger a follow-up sequence. From there we can expand into booking, event management, and ongoing client communication, but the intake piece is the milestone that decides success.
Key deliverables • A single lead-intake pipeline in GHL with clearly named stages • Form and API/webhook connections that import leads from our website and third-party sources in real time • Automated email/SMS thank-you plus internal notifications to staff • User roles and permissions so every staff member sees only what they need • A brief Loom or screen-share walkthrough so the team can hit the ground running
If you have examples of similar GoHighLevel builds—especially for event or entertainment businesses—please mention them when you respond. Let’s get our lead flow tidy and standardised so the rest of the system can follow.

item.title: WooCommerce Interactive Product Gallery Revamp

item.title: Convert Hardcoded Website into WordPress Theme -- 2
item.description:
30-250 USD | ## WordPress Developer Needed – Convert Existing Hardcoded Website into Theme Template Structure
We are looking for an experienced **WordPress developer** to convert an existing WordPress website that is currently built with mostly **hardcoded page layouts/content** into a properly structured, reusable **WordPress theme/template system**.
The goal is to keep the existing website's appearance and functionality while restructuring the code so that the site is easier to maintain, edit, and expand through WordPress.
Do not use third party free theme.
### Scope of Work
The developer will be responsible for:
* Review the existing WordPress website and current theme/code structure. * Convert hardcoded pages into proper reusable WordPress templates. * Create appropriate theme files such as:
* `header.php` * `footer.php` * `page.php` * `single.php` * `archive.php` * Custom product emplates page * Reusable template parts/components * Move repeated hardcoded sections into reusable theme components. * Convert hardcoded navigation into WordPress menu locations. * Convert editable page content so it can be managed through the WordPress admin area. * Use WordPress best practices for:
* Theme structure * Template hierarchy * PHP * HTML/CSS * JavaScript * WordPress hooks and functions * Properly enqueue CSS and JavaScript instead of hardcoding scripts/styles where applicable. * Preserve the existing responsive design and frontend appearance. * Preserve existing URLs and SEO structure wherever possible. * Make sure existing forms, scripts, plugins, and functionality continue to work. * Remove unnecessary or duplicated hardcoded code where appropriate. * Ensure the finished theme is clean, organized, and easy for another developer to maintain.
### Important
We are **not looking for a complete website redesign**.
The existing website design should remain substantially the same. The main objective is to improve the **WordPress theme architecture and backend maintainability**.
We would prefer that the website remain lightweight and avoid unnecessary page-builder dependencies unless there is a specific reason to use one.
### Desired Result
After completion:
1. The website should look essentially the same as the existing site. 2. Common elements should be controlled through reusable theme templates rather than duplicated hardcoded HTML. 3. Page content should be editable through WordPress where appropriate. 4. The theme should follow standard WordPress development practices. 5. Future pages should be easier to create using the established templates. 6. The code should be organized and documented sufficiently for another WordPress developer to continue working on it.
### Required Experience
Please apply only if you have strong experience with:
* Custom WordPress theme development * WordPress Template Hierarchy * PHP * HTML5 * CSS / responsive design * JavaScript * WordPress hooks and functions * Converting static or hardcoded websites into dynamic WordPress themes
Experience restructuring an existing custom WordPress website without changing its frontend design is strongly preferred.
### When Applying
Please include:
* Examples of custom WordPress themes you have developed. * Examples of websites you converted from hardcoded/static layouts into reusable WordPress templates. * A brief explanation of how you would approach this project. * Whether you will personally perform the development work. * Your estimated project cost or hourly rate.
Please begin your proposal with **“WORDPRESS THEME CONVERSION”** so we know you have read the complete project description.

Whether you implement this with Shopify’s built-in functions or a proven app, customers must be able to mix-and-match items into discounted sets and opt into auto-replenish deliveries at intervals I can control from the admin.
Deliverables • Fully responsive Shopify theme installed, customised, and branded • Product catalogue structure with one example collection and three sample products so I can duplicate the format • Bundles & subscription flow configured, tested, and documented for future edits • Basic pages (About, Contact, Shipping/Returns) styled to match the theme • Checkout, tax, and shipping settings reviewed for a US launch
Acceptance Criteria The store loads in under 3 seconds on mobile, all bundle/subscription selections calculate correct pricing through to checkout, and every editable area is explained briefly in a hand-off guide.
If you have a portfolio of live beauty or wellness shops, please share a couple of links so I can see your approach.

item.title: Acoustic Installations
item.description:

item.title: Shopify Store Setup & Coaching

item.title: SaaS 500 Error Fix & Enhancements

item.title: Publish Case Facts Online
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | My name and professional standing were questioned in a recent dispute, yet every formal finding shows the accusers were untruthful. item.title: Build Complete eCommerce Store

item.title: Clone Peptide Shop Website

item.title: Google Workspace Access & ChatGPT Linking
item.description:

item.title: Clean Portfolio & Blog Website

item.title: WordPress Content & Social Media Support
item.description: 2-8 USD/hr | We are a small residential cleaning business serving customers in Massachusetts. We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented freelancer to publish blog articles on our WordPress website and manage our three existing social media accounts. We will provide the article text. You will handle WordPress formatting and publishing, images, internal linking, basic on-page SEO, and social media scheduling. For privacy reasons, business identifying information and account links will be shared with shortlisted candidates during the interview process. Workload and Budget • Hourly rate: $5/hour • Initial trial: 4 weeks • Maximum workload: 8 hours per week • Weekly budget: $40 • Expected output: 2 published articles per week and approximately 3 posts per social media platform per week. Please confirm that you can complete the work within this schedule and budget. Hours must be tracked, and additional hours require approval in advance. 1. WordPress Blog Publishing Publish two articles per week using our existing WordPress website. We will supply the article text. Your responsibilities include: • Format articles with readable paragraphs, headings, lists, and appropriate spacing. • Find suitable images or create relevant images using AI. • Use royalty-free image sources such as: o https://www.pexels.com/ o https://unsplash.com/ o https://pixabay.com/ • Verify applicable image licenses and keep records of image sources. • Optimize images, use descriptive filenames, and add useful alt text. • Add a featured image and other relevant images as needed. • Write an appropriate SEO title and meta description using the existing SEO plugin. • Use one clear H1 heading and logical H2/H3 subheadings. • Check formatting, spelling, and links before publishing. • Provide the live URL for each published article. Articles should provide helpful information to homeowners about residential house cleaning. Images should primarily show indoor cleaning, including kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, and living areas. Do not copy images from Google Images or other websites without permission. 2. Internal Linking and On-Page SEO Each article should help readers discover relevant services and other useful website content. Please follow these guidelines: • Link naturally to one or two relevant service pages where appropriate. • Link to a relevant city-specific page when it genuinely helps the reader. • Link to related blog articles as the blog grows. • Use descriptive anchor text instead of repeatedly inserting exact-match keywords. • Avoid keyword stuffing and unnecessary links. • Verify that all destination URLs are correct and working. • Follow the existing website URL structure. • Do not change URLs, redirects, technical SEO settings, or existing page content without approval. 3. Social Media Management Manage three existing business social media accounts: Facebook, Instagram, and X. Account details will be provided during the interview process. Expected workload: approximately three posts per platform per week. Responsibilities include: • Create and schedule posts based on our supplied articles, cleaning tips, seasonal topics, and service information. • Adapt captions for each platform rather than copying identical text everywhere. • Use relevant images or graphics. • Share article links and other relevant website links where appropriate. • Focus on residential cleaning and the local communities served by the business. • Maintain a professional, helpful, consistent brand voice. • Check comments and messages within the allotted hours and notify us of potential customer inquiries. • Do not purchase followers, use spam tactics, or run paid advertising without approval. You may repurpose useful information from the weekly articles to create social posts, so you do not need to develop nine completely different topics every week. 4. Weekly Reporting Provide a brief weekly report containing: • The two published article URLs. • Images used and their sources. • Internal links added. • Links to social media posts published on each platform. • Total hours worked. • Any issues or recommendations. 5. Requirements Applicants should have: • Experience publishing articles in WordPress. • Basic knowledge of on-page SEO, metadata, image optimization, and internal linking. • Experience managing Facebook, Instagram, and X business accounts. • Good written English and strong attention to detail. • The ability to follow instructions and meet deadlines. • The ability to work independently within a limited weekly budget. Please include examples of WordPress articles you have published and social media accounts you have managed. Explain how you would organize this work within 8 hours per week. 6. Four-Week Paid Trial We will begin with a four-week paid trial. We will evaluate article quality, image selection, internal links, social media posts, communication, and reliability before deciding whether to continue. The 8-hour weekly limit is firm unless additional hours are approved in advance. Quality and accuracy are more important than publishing rushed or incomplete work. To apply, please confirm your availability, relevant experience, and ability to meet the weekly workload at $5/hour.
